test_title: PYST 01: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the sentence that uses a homonym of the underlined word:

Please **__close__** the window before leaving.

options.text: He forgot to close the file before shutting the laptop.
I always close the curtains at night.
Their bond grew close over the years.
Make sure to close the back door too.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined word in the sentence is "**close**," which is used to mean "shut" (e.g., close the window).
 
• Homonyms are words that sound or are spelled the same but have different meanings.
 
• In option 3, "**Their bond grew close over the years**," the word "close" is used as a homonym to mean "near" or "intimate," which is different from the meaning of "shut."
 
• Other options repeat the meaning of "close" as "shut" and do not demonstrate the use of a homonym.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Example:** *"Their bond grew close over the years," showing the homonym usage of the word "close."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "He forgot to close the file before shutting the laptop,"** – The word "close" here means "shut," similar to the original sentence.
 
• **Option 2: "I always close the curtains at night,"** – Again, "close" means "shut," similar to the original sentence.
 
• **Option 4: "Make sure to close the back door too,"** – The word "close" here also means "shut," similar to the original sentence.
 
• **Option 5:** – This option does not exist in the given question.
